package handler

import (
	db "example.com/auto-chess-practice/db"
	chess "example.com/auto-chess-practice/game/autochess"
	matchentity "example.com/auto-chess-practice/game/entities/chess_match"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"time"
)

type IChessMatchEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.ChessMatchDao
	TimerComp() *matchentity.TimerComponent
}
type IChessPlayerEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.PlayerDao
}

// 创建内存实体不代表已持久化；玩家建档必须经过一次正式事务。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerChessPlayerInit(p IChessPlayerEntity) error { p.Dao().SetInitialized(true); return nil }

// 成局名单、随机种子、配置、时间来自服务端。相同 Match ID 不允许改名单或重新掷种子。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerChessInit(m IChessMatchEntity, ids [chess.Seats]int64, r chess.Rules, seed string, now int64) (chess.View, error) {
	if m.Dao().GetState() != "" {
		s, e := chess.Decode(m.Dao().GetState())
		if e != nil {
			return chess.View{}, e
		}
		for i, id := range ids {
			if s.Seats[i].PlayerID != id {
				return chess.View{}, chess.ErrRule
			}
		}
		return s.View(ids[0])
	}
	s, e := chess.New(ids, r, seed, now)
	if e != nil {
		return chess.View{}, e
	}
	if e = saveChess(m, s); e != nil {
		return chess.View{}, e
	}
	return s.View(ids[0])
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerChessCommand(m IChessMatchEntity, playerID int64, c chess.Command, now int64) (chess.Receipt, error) {
	s, e := chess.Decode(m.Dao().GetState())
	if e != nil {
		return chess.Receipt{}, e
	}
	r, changed, e := s.Apply(playerID, c, now)
	if e != nil {
		return r, e
	}
	if changed {
		e = saveChess(m, s)
	}
	return r, e
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerChessView(m IChessMatchEntity, playerID int64) (chess.View, error) {
	s, e := chess.Decode(m.Dao().GetState())
	if e != nil {
		return chess.View{}, e
	}
	return s.View(playerID)
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerChessConnect(m IChessMatchEntity, playerID int64, ticket uint64, connected bool) error {
	s, e := chess.Decode(m.Dao().GetState())
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if e = s.Connect(playerID, ticket, connected); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	m.Dao().SetState(s.Encode())
	return nil
}

// 当前鉴权连接可查旧 Epoch 回执，但不能把旧命令换成新 Seq 重做。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerChessReceipt(m IChessMatchEntity, playerID int64, epoch, seq uint64) (chess.Receipt, error) {
	s, e := chess.Decode(m.Dao().GetState())
	if e != nil {
		return chess.Receipt{}, e
	}
	i := s.Index(playerID)
	if i < 0 || s.Seats[i].Epoch != epoch || seq == 0 || seq > uint64(len(s.Seats[i].Receipts)) {
		return chess.Receipt{}, chess.ErrRule
	}
	return s.Seats[i].Receipts[seq-1], nil
}

// Player 静态归属；本地同 database 示例用 MultiSync。跨 sid 应另接 Remote/Saga，不伪装成本地事务。
// Match 的 Claimed 与 Player 金币在同一个 strict 事务内；奖励仅由服务端终态排名推导。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerChessClaim(p IChessPlayerEntity, m IChessMatchEntity) (int64, error) {
	s, e := chess.Decode(m.Dao().GetState())
	if e != nil {
		return 0, e
	}
	i := s.Index(p.ID())
	if i < 0 || s.Phase != "done" || !p.Dao().GetInitialized() {
		return 0, chess.ErrRule
	}
	reward := int64((chess.Seats + 1 - s.Seats[i].Rank) * 10)
	if s.Seats[i].Claimed {
		return reward, nil
	}
	if p.Dao().GetGold() > 1000000-reward {
		return 0, chess.ErrRule
	}
	p.Dao().SetGold(p.Dao().GetGold() + reward)
	s.Seats[i].Claimed = true
	m.Dao().SetState(s.Encode())
	return reward, nil
}
func saveChess(m IChessMatchEntity, s chess.State) error {
	if id := m.Dao().GetWakeTimer(); id != 0 {
		m.TimerComp().RemoveTimer(id)
	}
	m.Dao().SetWakeTimer(0)
	m.Dao().SetState(s.Encode())
	if s.Deadline > 0 {
		id := m.TimerComp().NewTimerAt(time.UnixMilli(s.Deadline), matchentity.TimerPhase, s.Deadline, 0, nil)
		if id == 0 {
			return chess.ErrRule
		}
		m.Dao().SetWakeTimer(id)
	}
	return nil
}
